mapper.select:
SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.STDVALUE, B.CONCENTUNITNAME, B.UNCERTAINTY, B.UNCERTAINTYPERCENT, E.LOGTYPE, E.VENDORID, E.PRICE, F.MTLNAME, F.SPECIFICATION, F.MTLCATEGORYID, G.MTLCATEGORYNAME FROM T_EMC_STOCK A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT STOCKID, STDVALUE, CONCENTUNITNAME, UNCERTAINTY, UNCERTAINTYPERCENT FROM T_EMC_STOCK_CONCENT M WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_STOCK_CONCENT N WHERE M.STOCKID = N.STOCKID AND N.ID < M.ID) ) B ON A.ID = B.STOCKID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT VENDORID, PRICE, STOCKID, LOGTYPE FROM T_EMC_STOCK_LOG C WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_STOCK_LOG D WHERE C.STOCKID = D.STOCKID AND D.ID < C.ID) ) E ON A.ID = E.STOCKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MTL F ON A.MTLID = F.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MTL_CATEGORY G ON F.MTLCATEGORYID = G.ID) T
AND T.MTLCATEGORYNAME in ('标准样品','一般试剂')
AND T.STOCKQTY <= T.LOWLIMIT
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
SELECT T.* FROM T_EMC_STOCK T WHERE T.EXPIREDATE <= SYSDATE

SELECT T.MTLID FROM( SELECT T.*,B.MANAGEMENTTYPE FROM T_EMC_STOCK T LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MTL A ON T.MTLID = A.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MTL_CATEGORY B ON A.MTLCATEGORYID = B.ID WHERE T.STOCKQTY <= T.LOWLIMIT)T
GROUP BY T.MTLID

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT A.*, B.ORGID, B.MTLNAME, C.MANAGEMENTTYPE, D.CATEGORY, D.STDVALUE, D.UNCERTAINTY, D.UNCERTAINTYPERCENT, D.CONCENTUNITNAME, E.CREATEDBYNAME AS APPLYNAME, E.CREATEDTIME AS APPLYTIME, E.CREATEDBYORGNAME as APPLYORGNAME, E.PROCESSSTATUS AS APPLYSTATUS, E.ID AS APPLYID FROM T_EMC_STOCK A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MTL B ON A.MTLID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MTL_CATEGORY C ON B.MTLCATEGORYID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_STOCK_CONCENT D ON D.STOCKID = A.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MTL_APPLY E ON A.ID = E.STOCKID ) T
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_RUN R INNER JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT ON R.ID = OT.RUNID INNER JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT OTR ON OT.ID = OTR.ORDERTASKID INNER JOIN T_EMC_MTL_MAINTAIN_ITEM MMI ON OTR.TESTMETHODID= MMI.TESTMETHODID AND OTR.ITEMID= MMI.ITEMID INNER JOIN T_EMC_MTL_MAINTAIN MM ON MMI.MTLMAITAINID = MM.ID WHERE R.ID = #{runId} AND MM.MTLID = T.MTLID )
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_STOCK_LOG F WHERE F.STOCKID = T.ID AND F.LOGTYPE = '领取' AND F.RECEIVEDBYID = #{loginUser.id})
ORDER BY
T.MTLID,T.STANDARDLEVEL,T.BATCHNO,T.CATEGORY DESC
